items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The way that came about, he told me, is that his name was Sedgwick. That was his last name too. But his mother married a Stern. So he took the Stern name.

ctx.x: Yeah, Mike Stern’s sister. The way that came about, he told me, is that his name was Sedgwick. That was his last name too. But his mother married a Stern. So he took the Stern name. So that’s how it could be like it is. Then we found out she got a sister someplace. Somebody knew . . .
Edie Sedgwick. Yeah, the jazz thing. That’s a very talented group of people. Six degrees.
